b.x: What this field is

Psychological abuse is a pattern, over time, in which one person controls, humiliates, isolates, or makes the other doubt what they saw — until the house shrinks. It is not disagreeing on Tuesday. It is not the flood plan. It is not “alpha”. Brazil’s Maria da Penha law (11.340/2006) names psychological violence. This text is not a diagnosis, not a complaint, and it does not replace a police station, a public defender, or a doctor. It serves so the person can recognize the pattern and call outside.
DON'T

It does not teach controlling, isolating, flipping the blame, or “testing” someone. Whoever looks for a method here is in the wrong field. Discretion on the street is not silence inside an abusive house. Gray stops. The law enters.
The pattern that repeats
One episode does not close the case. Several, in the same direction, close the pattern. The person harmed starts to speak less, to ask permission for what was already theirs, to think they are crazy.
Humiliation that does not end. A nickname, a correction in front of others, a joke that hurts and “it was a joke”. The body of the house learns not to be funny.

Memory is put in doubt. “That did not happen.” “You invent things.” “You are too sensitive.” The person stops trusting what they saw. In ordinary talk this has a name: gaslight. It is not an argument. It is erasing the fact.
Isolation. Friend, family, work, church, group. Each outing becomes a fight, jealousy, or a staged exhaustion. In the end, only the one who controls remains.
Control of the everyday. Money, clothes, phone, schedule, food, friendship. “Where are you?” twenty times is not care. It is a fence.
A threat that does not need a shout. Breaking a thing, a look, days of silence, “if you leave I will kill myself”, “nobody will believe you”, “I keep the child”. Fear lives before the slap.
The blame always returns. The other apologizes for what they did not do. They explain the fact until the fact disappears. They never repair. Field 103.
The child becomes a messenger or a sentinel. They measure the mood. They hide a message. They hear “don’t tell”. That is abuse of the whole house, even with no hand on the child. Field 104.
What this pattern is not
One ugly fight, with an apology that changes the behavior afterward.
Agreeing, on Tuesday, who decides the exit in a flood. The function ends when the danger ends.
A clear limit: no shouting, no insults, no invading the phone. A limit does not isolate the person from the world.
Jealousy said once and corrected. Jealousy that becomes a fence, every month, is another fact.
What to do

If the danger is now — a shout, a threat, pursuit, a child in the middle — 190. If there is an injury, 192. Do not confront alone whoever has already threatened. Do not use the device the person reads, if the device is watched: another phone, a neighbor, work, a clinic.
180 — Brazil’s women’s hotline, 24 hours, also for psychological violence. Call from anywhere in Brazil.
100 — human rights. Child, adolescent, elder, person with a disability.
188 — if the anguish tightened and the person needs a voice now. It does not replace the police station.

Tell one person outside the house. One fact, one date, no novel. Keep a message, a photo of a broken object, a screenshot, if you can keep it without being seen. It is not revenge. It is memory the pattern tries to erase.
A document, medicine, and a little money in a place that does not depend on the other. The house kit is not a movie escape plan. It is not being left without the basics if you have to leave that day.
CAUTION

Do not stay to “work the craft” with whoever makes you doubt what you saw. Fields 102, 103, and 104 do not cover this. If the house is already afraid, the next step is not a guide. It is 180, 100, or 190.
